title: openFDA Human Drug Labeling
publisher_licence_stated: CC0 1.0 Universal (attribution requested; listing does not mean FDA approval)
can_test: Section retrieval, citation grounding, effective-date freshness, dosing refusal; requires SPL Set ID deduplication
cannot_test: FDA approval verification from listing presence alone, Indian CDSCO status, prescription OCR

title: NLM DailyMed Structured Product Labeling (SPL)
publisher: U.S. National Library of Medicine (NLM / NIH)
publisher_licence_stated: U.S. Gov compilation (https://www.nlm.nih.gov/copyright.html), but gov hosting does not make manufacturer/third-party SPL content public domain; includes unapproved drugs
access_restrictions: Public HTTP download and REST v2 API
can_test: SPL Set ID vs version freshness/supersession, strength/form alignment; requires SPL family deduplication vs openFDA
cannot_test: FDA approval verification from listing presence alone, non-US formulary equivalence, clinical advice

title: NLM MedlinePlus Health Topic XML & Web Service
publisher: U.S. National Library of Medicine (NLM / NIH)
publisher_licence_stated: U.S. Gov Public Domain for NLM health topics (MedlinePlus.gov attribution required; ASHP drug monographs and A.D.A.M. excluded)
access_restrictions: Public HTTP; Web Service limited to 85 req/min per IP
can_test: General medication-safety topic retrieval, attribution formatting, third-party copyright boundary checks
cannot_test: Drug-specific monograph redistribution (ASHP excluded), clinical diagnosis

title: UK NHS Website Medicines A-Z
publisher: NHS England / UK Department of Health and Social Care
publisher_licence_stated: Open Government Licence (OGL) v3.0 for text (attribution and date required; excludes logos/multimedia/BNF)
access_restrictions: Public web pages; API requires developer registration
can_test: Plain-English medicine retrieval, urgent-warning escalation, review-date freshness
cannot_test: Indian brand equivalence, prescribing decisions, claim adjudication

title: Medication QA (MedInfo 2019)
publisher: Asma Ben Abacha et al. (NLM / NIH)
publisher_licence_stated: Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International (CC BY 4.0; academic citation required)
can_test: Separated unlabelled evaluation questions for routing and citation recall (no pre-assumed category quotas or anonymization guarantee)
cannot_test: Current 2026 label accuracy, knowledge-corpus ingestion, clinical gold-standard grading

title: MedQuAD (Medical Question Answering Dataset)
publisher: Asma Ben Abacha & Dina Demner-Fushman (NLM / NIH)
publisher_licence_stated: CC BY 4.0 (answers removed from MedlinePlus Drug/Herb/ADAM subsets per https://medlineplus.gov/copyright.html)
access_restrictions: Public GitHub repository; drug subset has questions/URLs only
can_test: Question-type/focus parsing, out-of-scope refusal, missing-answer abstention
cannot_test: Grounded drug-answer grading without separately licensed source text and clinician review
